verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a plausible axis for a mobile app, so the story applies, but nothing in the evidence shows user-defined rules that fire actions on events. Notification setup, wearable mirroring and administrator-required hourly location sharing are fixed or admin-set behaviors, not rules the user defines, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
